notice: Finding IDs are stable. A profile lists the findings a dataset can legitimately support. The active profile is chosen by KNEESCOPE_FINDING_PROFILE and must match the loaded model's supported findings.

acl_tear.description: ACL tear (MRNet task 'acl'). Not interchangeable with the RSNA 'ACL' injury label.

meniscal_tear.description: Any meniscal tear, medial and lateral combined (MRNet task 'meniscus').

rsna4.note: Requires verified access to the RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection data, accepted rules, and enough labelled studies. Only a small subset of RSNA training studies carry labels.

mrnet3.note: Requires an approved MRNet data-use agreement. MRNet has no MCL label and no separate medial/lateral meniscus labels.

interaction_prototype.note: No usable training data. The product is an interaction prototype; every result is a fixture and no detection claim is made.
